name: Long Time no See, Mom
source:
You decide to watch the sunset at your parents' house. Everything seems fine...

Until, in the morning, you hear strange sounds and realize – there is someone else in the house.

[From [url=https://halkind.itch.io/long-time-no-see-mom]Itch.io[/url]]
